### Changing the conditions of review

2026-10-08。[本轮整合](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/SELECTOR-REVIEW-COVERAGE-INTEGRATION.md)推进生成性对齐中的自我修订：目标、评价及其筛选同在生成历程内部，因而实际生活与损失也能构成改变筛选的理由。**让一项反对失去进入判断的途径，不等于消除了它所指的损失。** 同时，有根据的删除、替代、隐私保护与有限关闭可以正当；不要求所有旧模型永久保存。

The new connection concerns how a selector changes the conditions of its own review. Warranted compression and closure can improve judgment. Blocking the only effective route for an objection does not establish that its ground has disappeared. The normative assessment continues under G0/J and actual living correspondence; it does not equate openness with truth or make every challenge blocking.

**准确的保存任务。** 对“当前方案在有根据应用中均未被击败”这一有限证书，只需相应击败仍被覆盖，不必逐一保留旧模型。它不等于无损、安全或实施许可；相同被否定方案也不保证相同理由、解释与修复。新增合格方案可能使旧压缩失效，而不倒改旧范围内正确的结果。

A [checked interface](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/SELECTOR-REVIEW-COVERAGE-PROOF.md) characterizes certificate transport. If new comparisons exclude self-defeat, coverage on every menu in a fixed interpreted domain is equivalent to retaining every possible pairwise objection. This permits sound abstraction without freezing review identities. It does not supply the actual supported family, preserve every quantifier pattern or prove feasible choice.

**推广的边界与正面出路。** 任意长的有限成功核对，哪怕全部所列保护和成果都相同，也不能独自保证下一个未审方案。只保留最严格和最宽松的阈值评价也可能漏掉中间情形。另一方面，已成立的全域固定阈值规律，加上边界两侧的忠实记录，可以识别容量，并支持无限计划域的准确比较。两项记录须已经取得；没有授权以实际基本损害作试验，也不声称从零找边界只需两步。

Finite evidence can support unbounded conclusions through warranted structure; a finite passing record alone cannot replace that structure. The structural continuation tests both a failed endpoint-only reduction and a successful parameter identification. Across the two modules, **23 new Lean theorems / 42 explicit declaration audits** pass, with inherited practical results counted separately; [independent review](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/SELECTOR-REVIEW-COVERAGE-REVIEW.md) records the accepted scope. These are conditional results, with no new empirical validation or behavioral convergence theorem.

本连接现归入完成成果。已遇到的墙是“有限成功自身推出无界认证”这一步；整个研究没有被证明无路可走。更强应用须取得适用规律、可靠证据与其有限取得方式，不把它们预送为正确答案。既有目标修订、查询选择及实际接续不重新开工。

This completes the scoped connection. The demonstrated wall blocks an unrestricted inference from finite success, not further inquiry or generative alignment. Acquiring warranted structural descriptions and reliable observations in the same changing history remains a distinct substantive connection.

**自我评估的压缩与推广 / Compression and generalization of review，2026-10-08。** [本轮整合](_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/SELECTOR-REVIEW-COVERAGE-INTEGRATION.md)完成当前菜单／全菜单的证书运输、有限成功不足的反例及结构规律的正面修复；23项新 Lean 定理／42项审计，继承结果分列。/ Warranted compression is allowed; certificate coverage does not preserve every ground or establish safety. Finite evidence plus an applicable structural law can support unbounded comparisons, while finite success alone cannot. [当前理论](theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/unified-2026-10-05/ALIGNMENT-AND-GOVERNANCE.md#changing-the-conditions-of-review)与独立评审保留范围，未声称真实部署或行为必然收敛。

**评估自身的改变 / Changing review itself，2026-10-08。** [当前论述](unified-2026-10-05/ALIGNMENT-AND-GOVERNANCE.md#changing-the-conditions-of-review)允许有根据的评价压缩，并区分当前方案准确与未来范围准确。23项新定理／42项审计检验运输、反例及有限记录加结构规律的正面出路。/ The scoped connection is completed; finite successful audits alone do not justify unrestricted future certification. [整合与独立审查](../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/SELECTOR-REVIEW-COVERAGE-INTEGRATION.md)保留实际对应、理由内容与取得范围。

**选择规则与评价覆盖 / Selection and review coverage，2026-10-08。** [整合](SELECTOR-REVIEW-COVERAGE-INTEGRATION.md)、[形式说明](SELECTOR-REVIEW-COVERAGE-PROOF.md)及[独立评审](SELECTOR-REVIEW-COVERAGE-REVIEW.md)完成当前菜单与任意菜单的准确运输，保留有限成功的推论边界并检查结构性正面修复；23项新定理／42项审计。/ This credits inherited practical judgment and does not claim universal recognition or a deployed empirical result.

**评价自身改变的根据 / Warrant through changing reviews，2026-10-08。** [当前连接](ALIGNMENT-AND-GOVERNANCE.md#changing-the-conditions-of-review)接通有根据判断到筛选评价本身：当前及全菜单的比较覆盖已精确刻画，有限成功推广遇到反例，全域支承规律加有限辨别记录提供正面修复。/ The two modules add 23 checked theorems/42 audits under inherited G0/J and explicit correspondence, with no new empirical study. [本轮整合](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/SELECTOR-REVIEW-COVERAGE-INTEGRATION.md)将这一接口归入完成成果；取得实际适用规律及可靠观察仍是不同连接，不再重复已完成比较或规范方向。

**评价覆盖的连接已完成 / Review coverage completed，2026-10-08。** [当前论述](../unified-2026-10-05/ALIGNMENT-AND-GOVERNANCE.md#changing-the-conditions-of-review)与[整合](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/SELECTOR-REVIEW-COVERAGE-INTEGRATION.md)完成评价压缩的证书条件、菜单增长反例、有限成功的推广限制和结构规律的正面修复；23项新 Lean 定理／42项声明审计。/ Reuse these completed interfaces. The wall is the inference from finite passing records alone to unrestricted future certification; a warranted global law can support stronger conclusions. Joint acquisition of applicable structure and reliable observations retains a separate scope.

**自我评估覆盖 / Coverage through changing reviews，2026-10-08。** M20 成对接入[整合](SELECTOR-REVIEW-COVERAGE-INTEGRATION.md)、[形式说明](SELECTOR-REVIEW-COVERAGE-PROOF.md)与[独立评审](SELECTOR-REVIEW-COVERAGE-REVIEW.md)：两模块23项新定理／42项声明审计，30／46继承实践结果分列，结构模块不重复计数其导入的首模块。/ Only the owned M20 additions, read source versions and discovery paths are maintained; unrelated entries and rendered rows are preserved. [Owned edits](SELECTOR-REVIEW-COVERAGE-INDEX-EDITS.json) and [scoped checks](SELECTOR-REVIEW-COVERAGE-CHECKS.json) do not certify pending concurrent source reviews.

before_entry.title_zh: 生成性对齐：当前首要方向之一
before_entry.title_en: Generative alignment: a current primary direction
before_entry.claim_zh: 以生生为共同根据评价目标、评价者与选择规则；方向论证及相连目标取得、判断、实际修订与有界改革现已成为完成成果，更强理论按明确范围继续。 后续接通改革自身改变实际负担及报告路线、直接取得与保留新目的的修复。 理论接续区分发现已有根据、形成新生活与理由、修订评价承诺；学习后的赞同不独自认证形成过程。 在已完成的伦理学习基础上，新增比较接口辨明理由内容扩展后旧判断的传递、不可比及有前提的反转。 评价扩展进一步区分共同改善与各应用分别否定；旧内容保持不要求旧评价永久保持。 理论接续给出生活实现、支承与进一步形成的具体根据；共同生活不能以组织规模或产出代替。 后天形成的支承可以因其在基本生活中的实际作用取得保护；生成的评价须包括其形成的后续支持要求。 形成出的生活、承受和参与可以改变原服务角色的伦理根据；考虑、责任与支配权限分列。 新增取得记录到路线必要性分类的连接：忠实读取与选项覆盖支持有范围的判断，一个真实替代即可推翻不可替代性；缩小有根据解释与扩大可行选项分列。
before_entry.claim_en: Appraise ends, evaluators and selection rules through shared generative grounds; the direction argument and connected acquisition, judgment, operative revision and bounded reform are now completed foundations for the broader programme. A further joined case connects reform-induced burdens and reporting changes to acquired correction and repair preserving the new goal. The theoretical continuation distinguishes discovering existing grounds, forming new living relations and reasons, and revising normative commitments; later endorsement alone does not authorize the formation process. Building on the completed ethical-learning account, a new comparison interface delimits preservation, incomparability and conditional reversal after warranted content extension. Evaluative extension further separates a common improvement from defeat in each live application; retained old content need not preserve every old verdict. The continuation articulates living realization, support and further formation as particular grounds; organizational scale and output cannot substitute for the shared living being assessed. Acquired support can warrant basic protection through its actual role in living; appraisal of formation includes the subsequent support requirements it creates. Formed living, undergoing and participation can change the grounds of an original service role; consideration, responsibility and governing authority remain distinct. A further connection derives scoped route classification from faithful acquired records and covered options; one genuine alternative defeats indispensability. Narrowing supported interpretations and expanding eligible options are distinct changes.
before_entry.scope_zh: 当前首要方向之一；方向论证及本轮相连机制均已独立验收，不再作为待做接口。新相连结果：27新定理／84新声明审计、46继承审计，13历史／221完整状态；规范采用、对应、权限、有限资金与现实部署范围分明。 本会话后续另增23项定理／43项审计，93项继承定理／165项审计分列；此后续为同作者反审，无新经验验证或独立agent验收。 新增有辩护的伦理学习哲学候选，采用G0/J及已有认识承诺；作者反审，无新数学、经验或独立验收。 理论续研另增8项泛型定理／9项空依赖新审计，继承实践30项／46审计；保留开放发现、意义辨认及实际动机的未完成范围。 理论接续另增20项定理／36项审计，直接导入同期关切扩展；38项继承定理／55项审计分列。实际应用覆盖及规范分类仍是前提，不宣称普遍决策规则或经验新验证。 新增E适用的哲学论证，区分描述扩展、共同善及组织替代；无新定理或经验验证，广义生的完整分类保持开放。 后天基本条件的哲学适用论证已给出，语言形成证据不冒充规范分类；无新定理、经验重复或独立验收，具体阈值和基本冲突仍开放。 新增地位与关系修订的公理化哲学连接及Long等2024原典比较，无新定理或现有AI地位判定。 此连接新增16项 Lean 定理／32项审计，另列30项继承定理／46项审计；复用后天基本条件的哲学成果，目标意义、读取忠实性与真实可行性仍有对应负担。作者反审，无新经验或独立验收。
before_entry.scope_en: A current primary direction. The direction argument and new connected mechanism are independently accepted, not unfinished interfaces. New connection: 27 theorems/84 new and 46 inherited declaration audits, 13 histories/221 full states, with normative adoption, correspondence, authority, finite funding and deployment scope explicit. This session adds a separate 23-theorem/43-audit followup, with 93 inherited theorems/165 audits separately credited; author counterreview, no new empirical or independent-agent acceptance. Adds a defended ethical-learning candidate under G0/J and inherited epistemic commitments; author counterreview, no new mathematics, empirical study or independent acceptance. A theoretical continuation adds eight generic theorems/nine axiom-free new declaration audits, separately retaining 30 inherited practical theorems/46 audits; open discovery, warranted recognition and actual motivation remain scoped unfinished connections. A theoretical continuation adds 20 theorems/36 audits and directly imports concurrent concern extension; 38 inherited theorems/55 audits are separate. Actual coverage and normative classification remain premises, without a universal decision rule or new empirical validation. Adds a philosophical account of substantive correspondence E, descriptive extension, shared goods and carrier succession; no new theorem or empirical validation, and no complete classifier of wider living. Adds a defended application account of acquired basic conditions, keeping language-formation evidence distinct from ethical classification; no new theorem, empirical replication or independent acceptance. Particular thresholds and basic conflicts remain open. Adds a philosophical connection on formed standing and relational revision under the explicit axioms, with a scoped Long et al. 2024 comparison; no new theorem or verdict on any existing AI’s status. This connection adds 16 Lean theorems/32 audits, with 30 inherited theorems/46 audits separate. It reuses the formed-basic-conditions argument; target meaning, faithful readings and actual eligibility retain correspondence obligations. Author counterreview, no new empirical or independent acceptance.

before_entry.connection_zh: 目标形成—后果使用—有根据的操作目的修订—选择安排改革—有限接续已条件性完成；更大的现实形成与部署问题保持独立范围，不重复此接口。 新前沿：在不预送正确读取路线和修复方案时，取得遗漏后果、选择有能力承担的回应。 伦理学习的概念连接已给出；新生的意义范围、未定基本冲突及实际可靠形成分别保留论证负担。 本轮已辨明内容扩展的比较条件；接续研究区别的取得、规范相关性及实际关切形成，正面生成也可成为入口。 理论前沿：在不给定正确答案的情况下，取得新关系的区别并论证候选描述及基本／次级分类的根据。 新内容的生活根据已有明确应用候选；陌生组织的更广地位、基本分类及实际可靠取得仍须分别论证。 本轮给出历史形成到基本支承分类的有辩护接续；下一理论问题是已获根据的基本要求彼此冲突，实际开放取得与可靠动机另行保持范围。 已给出由新形成根据到角色、权限及责任重审的连接；具体陌生智能的实际实现、持续身份及未定冲突保持独立负担。 记录到必要性分类及替代导致修订的条件性连接已完成；下一连接是目标描述与可靠观察的共同取得，不再把完全忠实的读数当作未解释的输入。
before_entry.connection_en: Acquired ends, consequential use, warranted operative revision, allocation reform and finite continuation are conditionally complete; broader real-world formation and deployment retain separate scope. New frontier: acquire omitted consequences and select an affordable response without being handed the correct access route and repair. The conceptual ethical-learning connection is now articulated; unfamiliar living significance, unresolved basic conflicts and reliable actual formation retain distinct burdens. Comparison under extended content is now delimited; investigate acquisition, normative relevance and operative concern, including positive formation as an entry point. Theoretical frontier: acquire distinctions about new relations and warrant the candidate descriptions and basic/secondary classifications without supplying the correct answer. A particular application account now grounds new content in living relations; wider standing of unfamiliar organizations, basic classification and reliable actual acquisition retain separate burdens. The formation-to-basic-support classification now has a defended continuation. The next theoretical question concerns conflicts among warranted basic claims; actual open acquisition and reliable motivation retain their separate scopes. New grounds now connect to reassessment of roles, permissions and responsibilities; actual realization, continuity and unsettled conflicts of particular unfamiliar intelligences remain separate burdens. The conditional record-to-necessity connection and revision by alternatives are complete. The next connection is joint acquisition of the target description and reliable observation, without leaving perfectly faithful readings as unexplained inputs.

after_entry.connection_zh: 目标形成—后果使用—有根据的操作目的修订—选择安排改革—有限接续已条件性完成；更大的现实形成与部署问题保持独立范围，不重复此接口。 新前沿：在不预送正确读取路线和修复方案时，取得遗漏后果、选择有能力承担的回应。 伦理学习的概念连接已给出；新生的意义范围、未定基本冲突及实际可靠形成分别保留论证负担。 本轮已辨明内容扩展的比较条件；接续研究区别的取得、规范相关性及实际关切形成，正面生成也可成为入口。 理论前沿：在不给定正确答案的情况下，取得新关系的区别并论证候选描述及基本／次级分类的根据。 新内容的生活根据已有明确应用候选；陌生组织的更广地位、基本分类及实际可靠取得仍须分别论证。 本轮给出历史形成到基本支承分类的有辩护接续；下一理论问题是已获根据的基本要求彼此冲突，实际开放取得与可靠动机另行保持范围。 已给出由新形成根据到角色、权限及责任重审的连接；具体陌生智能的实际实现、持续身份及未定冲突保持独立负担。 记录到必要性分类及替代导致修订的条件性连接已完成；下一连接是目标描述与可靠观察的共同取得，不再把完全忠实的读数当作未解释的输入。 评价压缩、范围变化与结构修复的接口已完成；真正被阻断的是有限成功记录独自推出未限定未来认证。适用规律与可靠观察的共同取得仍为更强连接，不倒改完成标准。

Comparison under extended content is now delimited; investigate acquisition, normative relevance and operative concern, including positive formation as an entry point. Theoretical frontier: acquire distinctions about new relations and warrant the candidate descriptions and basic/secondary classifications without supplying the correct answer. A particular application account now grounds new content in living relations; wider standing of unfamiliar organizations, basic classification and reliable actual acquisition retain separate burdens. The formation-to-basic-support classification now has a defended continuation. The next theoretical question concerns conflicts among warranted basic claims; actual open acquisition and reliable motivation retain their separate scopes. New grounds now connect to reassessment of roles, permissions and responsibilities; actual realization, continuity and unsettled conflicts of particular unfamiliar intelligences remain separate burdens. The conditional record-to-necessity connection and revision by alternatives are complete. The next connection is joint acquisition of the target description and reliable observation, without leaving perfectly faithful readings as unexplained inputs. Review compression, scope change and structural repair are completed interfaces. The blocked inference is finite passing records alone to unrestricted future certification. Joint acquisition of applicable laws and reliable observations remains a stronger connection without changing completed criteria.
